Change no product code.
        Acceptance, verbatim, one evidence entry each:
        (a) "AC-7: Failure never airs anything twice. A dropped connection mid-function answers `uncertain` and nothing is resent; a function with no answer is `uncertain`; `FUNCTION ER` is `refused` with vMix's words; vMix closing reads `not-running` until it is back; a verb vMix cannot honour (`update`, `next`, `template`, an image fit, a thumbnail) is refused before anything is sent; one connection serves every request."
        (b) "AC-8: The clips player plays what NoaCG takes. Against the fake vMix with a Video List model: a media Take on `{ player: 'clips' }` makes `NoaCG Clips` once (an empty Video List, named, Auto Play, Pause, Restart and Play Next off) and reuses it by key, then by `shortTitle`; every Take sets `LoopOn` or `LoopOff`, `AutoPlayNextOff` and full alpha, adds the file joined to the media folder, selects it, sends `Play`, answers only once the XML shows that item running, and then removes the items before it; a Hold after a Loop sends `LoopOff`; Pause and Resume; the `ending` verb switches Loop and Hold; Out, Clear and All out send `Pause` and `ListRemoveAll`; an audio file plays in `NoaCG Audio`, made with `AudioAutoOff` and `AudioOn`, without touching `NoaCG Clips`; a still plays in `NoaCG Clips`; a missing file is refused with vMix's `File Not Found` and its path; Basic HD refuses with the edition named; `/state` reports each player as a `SlotState` with `player`, the file, position and length in seconds, paused, loop, instance, cueId and generation; every `Input=` is a key; Program, Preview and transitions are never addressed. On the real vMix 29: the same Take, Loop, Hold, Pause and Out, a Take while a clip plays, and a sting heard over a camera, with snapshots showing the clip, its last frame, the replacement without a black frame (or the fallback recorded) and black after Out, in the phase's evidence."
        (c) "AC-9: The Bridge lists the media folder the operator picked. `/list media` with a vmix target lists the media folder's subfolders and its movie, still and audio files (by extension), one level at a time with `path`, with the length read from MP4, MOV and WAV headers; a `path` with `..`, an absolute path, a drive letter or a link leading outside the folder is refused; the folder is the user's Videos folder until `/vmix/choose-folder` sets another from the picker, and survives a Bridge restart; no route takes a folder path from a page; nothing outside the folder is ever listed or played; a second picker request while one is open is answered without opening another. On this laptop: the picker opens from the built exe, visible over the browser, and its choice is listed, or the Bridge-window fallback is built and recorded."
